title: The Slag Flume Strike
logline: Trade apprentices take over an orbital foundry's slag flume to protest lethal night-shift quotas, and their overseer hires mercenaries while the union organizer begs for a courier.

roles.description: Hard-nosed industrial manager squeezed between quarterly quotas and aging equipment.
Third-year crucible worker chosen by fellow apprentices to speak for the shift.
A private security gunship deployed by the overseer to clear the gantries.
A massive, soot-blackened smelting station orbiting a ferrite asteroid.
The heavy industrial cartel that owns the foundries and writes indenture terms.

public_situation: Red slag vents light up {role:orbital_foundry} as apprentice crews barricade the secondary crucible gantries in a wildcat strike.
private_truth: The overseer locked the emergency blast dampers to hide the fact that three apprentices died of toxic fumes on the previous shift.

beats.public_change: The foundry consortium declares an illegal wildcat strike and locks habitat docks.

missions.reason: The delegate needs an outside pilot to slip past the picket and collect the maintenance shift logbook from the crucible airlock.
missions.private_fact: The logbook records the overseer's direct order overriding the safety ventilation alarms before the fatal shift.

beats.public_change: The overseer brings in a private security gunship to sweep the exterior heat exchangers.

missions.reason: The delegate begs the pilot to destroy the security gunship before its targeting lasers burn through the habitat life support lines.
missions.private_fact: The apprentices have rigged the slag dampers to vent into space, threatening to poison the station's docking ring if fired upon.

beats.public_change: Consortium enforcers offer a massive bounty for the logbook, while the delegate tries to transmit it to the regional labor board.

missions.reason: Needs a pilot to scan the foundry's main exhaust manifold to corroborate the toxic spike recorded in the logbook.
missions.private_fact: The manifold still holds trace residue of the prohibited solvent the overseer ordered to speed up cleaning.

beats.public_change: Consortium auditors dock at the primary ring to negotiate terms or authorize lethal clearance.

missions.reason: The delegate needs the certified manifold findings and logbook carried directly to the consortium auditor's shuttle before security breaches the gantry.
missions.private_fact: The overseer is waiting at the docking bay with a private discretionary payoff fund.

player_choice.prompt: The overseer offers to buy the evidence off the pilot on the catwalk, while the delegate watches from behind the blast doors.

options.label: Hand the chemical proof to the consortium auditor
Sell the logbook and scans to the overseer for cash
Broker an increased apprenticeship stipend while burying the deaths

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot delivers the evidence to the auditor and defeats the security gunship.
resolutions.summary: The consortium arrests {role:foundry_overseer} for negligence and grants the apprentices shorter shifts and safety monitors.

consequences.public_summary: A hired gun carried proof of poisoned blast ducts and broke an overseer's hold on apprentice smelters.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot sells the logbook to the overseer.
resolutions.summary: {role:foundry_overseer} destroys the logs, militarizes the foundries, and blacklists {role:apprentice_delegate} across the sector.

consequences.public_summary: Word spread of a pilot taking management coin to bury the names of dead furnace apprentices.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot brokers a quiet financial settlement.
resolutions.summary: Apprentice wages rise while the fatal toxic leak is officially reclassified as an unpreventable valve failure.

resolutions.reached_by: The assault succeeds or the pilot abandons the contract.
resolutions.summary: Security forces gas the gantry catwalks, ending the mutiny and returning the furnaces to full output.

loose_threads.detail: Foundry alloy purchase orders surged three jumps away twelve hours before the walkout was called.
The toxic solvent barrels bear falsified maritime safety stamps originating from an offshore holding firm.

radio_hooks: Slag vents glow at {role:orbital_foundry} as shift workers refuse crucible rotation.
{role:foundry_consortium} warns freight captains against harboring unauthorized personnel.

voice_direction.foundry_overseer: Harsh, impatient cadence, drops pronouns and rushes through sentences. Never admits technical ignorance.
voice_direction.apprentice_delegate: Raspy, restrained vocal delivery, speaks in measured, deliberate phrases. Avoids discussing personal fear.
